label: Self-origination assessed through the existing existential-production proof
summary: Warrant and derivation assessment of the bare STMT-NOTHING-ORIGINATES-ITSELF, without premise discharge. DEF-CAUSE-OF-ORIGIN paraphrases an originating cause as 'other than the thing itself', but its primitive CausesOrigin field does not enforce distinctness and the conclusion is not obtained by that definition. The previously verified noSelf result from four OPEN mixed-token priority conditions excludes an act producing its own bearer's existence: an occurring exercise presupposes its bearer's existence, production of existence is explanatorily prior to its product, and one transitive irreflexive order forbids the resulting two-step cycle. No temporal precedence is needed. New explicit bridge OriginHasProductiveExercise says that each CausesOrigin c x edge has an occurring exercise a borne by c that produces x's existence. New argument noSelfOriginFromNoSelfProduction derives the bare target from this OPEN bridge plus the existing NoSelfProduction statement; the latter retains its four-premise certified support route. The Solution also contains a direct Lean composition invoking the prior noSelf theorem. The challenge, corpus argument/result and comparator configuration are registered; their new formal verification remains subject to CI. Ordinary self-repair, feedback after existence and an intrinsic nonproductive explanation do not instantiate production of one's own existence. The strongest distinct rival proposes simultaneous/non-well-founded origination for which bearer-to-act or act-to-product priority fails. The existing unique-feedback Boolean control shows consistency of a feedback constraint, not an actual existential-origin mechanism or independent warrant for that denial. Provisional judgment: the prohibition is strongly supported for genuinely productive origin under the five explicit open premises, while the universal primitive statement stays unestablished. Independent semantic challenge found no P1 in the staged bridge/proof/records and identified this bookkeeping update as P2. No new source attribution or rival refutation is claimed.
blocker: Defend the applicability of the now-explicit OriginHasProductiveExercise interpretation bridge to actual originating causes, and justify the bearer-to-act, act-to-product, transitive and irreflexive explanatory-priority commitments for that production. A feedback rival needs a concrete origination mechanism, not merely consistent equations. Until then the derived conclusion is conditional and the root premise remains open; final Lean/Comparator/NanoDa verification is pending CI.
